mods.title: V.S. TABI Ex Boyfriend OG/V1 (V-Slice Port)
mods.description: WARNING!!This Port Is Not The 2022 Remake Or Revival Version Of The Vs Tabi Mod, This Is The OG Version (To Be Specific, The First Version Released On Gamebanana) Remade From The Ground Up For V-Slice/Mobile Users,Also, (Hopefully This Doesent Anger Most People) I Used Video Cutscenes For The Dialogues in Story Mode,All Credits Go To The OG Vs Tabi Team.Original Description Of The Mod:Your girlfriend, invited by her dad's friend for some unknown reason, asks you to come along with her. When you arrive at the place, there was no one, except for one weird guy that scared your girlfriend out. Will everything go well or is something bad going to happened.Turns out he was your girlfriend's EX-boyfriend, Tabi, which she had broke up with a year ago. When they both started dating, he was a novice music producer who had passion and love for his work, that was until he met her dad.Your girlfriend's dad, being an ex-rockstar, wanted his little girl to be just like him, that's why they both started using Tabi for their advantage. Years had passed since they were together, when Tabi suddenly came to notice that his girlfriend was using him for her own career and didn't care about him at all. And at the time, he even lost his career helping his girlfriend to become a star. Once she knew he understood everything, a couple of guys came to Tabi's house and kidnapped him. He woke up in some alleyway without clothes and.. surprisingly, without his body. To his shock, it was invisible except his hand that was pure bones. He knew who did this to him right away.. her dad.. he must revenge.. he must kill them both... Another year had passed, he made a plan and he's ready to execute it.For Newer People On The Fnf Modding Community, I Inserted A How To Install.txt File On How To Install This in Game, Be Sure To Follow it Correctly!Well, With Nothing Else To Say,Hopefully You Had Fun With This Port! :D

mods.title: VS. Tinky Winky
mods.description: Made by the people who brought you the mod Tubby Night Funkin'"VS. Tinky Winky" is a Full Week, Friday Night Funkin' mod that is base off the mod "Tubby Night Funkin'". This mod is available on V-SLICE/BASE GAME engine with MOBILE SUPPORT along with it. Lore: Boyfriend and Girlfriend head into Teletubbieland for a little picnic date. With the power of Girlfriends demonic powers, She disguises themselves as Teletubbies to fit right in. Since you know, Teletubbies have never seen humans besides within their belly tv screens. This mod was created to be the last Friday NIght Funkin' mod that I will ever be creating. I wanted to show my evolution with the fnf artstyle, as I've come a long way from it since then. There was going to be a little more content in this mod, like extra songs and in-game cutscenes to better flesh out the mod's story a bit. I didn't wanted to spend as much time just to make a small mod (It took 6 months to make this mod)Q: Will there be any more updates to VS. Tinky Winky?A: There will be no other major content added into the mod, there will mainly just be bug fixes and more compatibility in which it will be supported on future updates of the base Friday Night Funkin' game itself.Thank you to the people who have been around for my Friday Night Funkin' content. This my last Friday Night Funkin' Mod, I will never make another mod again. I am off to start on newer projects/ideas and most of all, my future into art and animation as a whole.

mods.description: Welcome to SONIC JAMJAMMIN' NEW WEEKTake on the World's Most Famous Hedgehog in WEEK SONIC, a 3-song original level with songs inspired by the rich soundtracks of Sonic CD, Sonic R,Sonic Adventure, and beyond! Revisit a classic locale, experience dazzling hand-drawn cutscenes, and rhyme at super-sonic speeds! Can you keep up?PLAYABLE SONIC CAMPAIGNDr. Eggman's got a new path to world domination-- the POWER of MUSIC! Using his greatest creation, METAL SONIC, the Doctor's taking over the city's musical culture to harness its unlimited musical power. What's worse... is that they're convinced METAL SONIC is the REAL SONIC! But Sonic's not the slacker type. Take back the city's music and clear Sonic's name through intricately crafted 'Sonic Mixes' of FNF's unforgettable soundtrack. On top of beating a song flawlessly, you'll need to style on your enemies with a brand new taunt system. After hitting a combo, you'll be able to chain taunts to the rhythm until your next turn. Pull off a sweet chain, and you'll get crazy bonuses that'll shoot you straight to the top! Every SICK note you hit gets added to your SCORE, so be sure to rack up enough for a massive score bonus at the end. Make a name for yourself on the charts as the most stylish MC alive!

mods.title: Character Select PLUS!
mods.description: More Character Slots completely upgrades the Friday Night Funkin' Character Select screen! Instead of being limited to the default 9 slots, you can add more rows directly from Character Select using the + and - buttons, with support for up to 81 character slots. You can also drag and drop characters to rearrange them however you want — no more going into the game's files just to change where a character appears! Features: Choose anywhere from 9 to 81 character slots + / - buttons add or remove 3 slots at a time Drag and drop characters to rearrange them Your character arrangement is saved automatically Your selected number of slots is saved Scroll through additional rows with the mouse wheel Use the arrow keys to navigate extra rows Scroll while dragging characters to move them between distant rows Automatically adds enough slots if you have more playable characters than your current layout can hold Designed to work with other playable character mods Installation: Download and extract the mod. Place the mod folder into your Friday Night Funkin' mods folder. Launch the game and enable the mod if necessary. Open Character Select and customize your layout! The minimum is the original 3×3 (9-slot) layout, so you can still keep Character Select looking like vanilla FNF if you want. If you find a bug or a playable character mod that doesn't work correctly with this, leave a comment with the error and I'll take a look!
